messages:
teo_newrep: Hey all  Teo here, new AE. Quick blocker: I can't access Salesforce (SSO returns an error) and Dialpad shows no extension. Also can't find the latest sell-sheet or call battlecard. Who should I ping?

maya-ops: welcome @teo_newrep! Tagging IT. Did you hit the "Request apps" link in the onboarding checklist? That kicks off provisioning.

teo_newrep: yep did the checklist but maybe skipped the app form. SSO flows back to the IdP with 'auth failed'. Dialpad web shows "no extension assigned".

maya-ops: ok i'll open a ticket. @it-queue-bot can you create a provisioning ticket for Teo: Salesforce (AE), Dialpad extension, add to /sales/collateral drive, and grant playbook access?

it-queue-bot: Ticket created: IT-3244  "Provision: teo_newrep  Salesforce + Dialpad + collateral". Assigned: maya-ops-admin. ETA: 3 hours. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/IT-3244

drew_sdr: hey Teo, while ops sorts it, you can use Dialpad mobile for calls. Also quick VM script I use: `Hi, this is [Name] from Redwood Inference. We help teams cut inference costs. Can I steal 10 minutes next week to show a quick idea?`

teo_newrep: thanks Drew. Where's the sell-sheet and the battlecard? I want to start customizing outreach.

maya-ops: Sell-sheet (one-pager) is at internal link: https://redwood.example.com/sales/sell-sheet-v2. Battlecard + objection responses are in the drive folder /sales/collateral/battlecards. I'll add you once ticket finishes.

sales-ops-bot: Pro tip: enable HubSpot email sync (settings -> integrs -> email) and set auto-cc to redwood-sales@redwood.com for call logging. Also templates: outbound sequence named "AE - Intro V2" in the sequences library.

it-queue-bot: IT-3244 update: Salesforce SSO logs show missing group mapping for AE. Applying mapping now. Dialpad license assigned pending routing profile. Collateral folder shared once access complete.

teo_newrep: quick question  do we have a standard voicemail for enterprise prospects? want to match tone.

drew_sdr: for enterprise keep it slightly more formal: `Hi, this is [Name] with Redwood Inference. I'm reaching out about your team's LLM inference needs. Please leave a time to connect or reply to my email and I'll follow up.`

maya-ops: IT-3244 status: Completed. Salesforce AE group mapped, SSO working. Dialpad extension assigned (EXT-6099) and desktop client provisioned. Added teo_newrep to /sales/collateral and #sales-playbooks. Closed by maya-ops-admin at 2026-03-23T20:01:40Z.

teo_newrep: I can confirm Salesforce & Dialpad desktop work and I see the sell-sheet + battlecard folder. Thanks all!!

onboarding-bot: Welcome DM sent to teo_newrep with quickstart checklist, onboarding links, and 1:1 scheduling: https://cal.com/redwood/sales-30

maya-ops: added a 30-min walkthrough for tomorrow to go over playbooks, sequences, and demo booking. Ping me if you want the outbound templates earlier. :tada:
